description: Ozorek, a living beefsteak fungus, a big fleshy blood-red bracket fungus shaped like a huge tongue of raw meat, its surface wet and glistening and oozing red juice, a wide toothless mouth on its underside, small dark eyes, creeping on thick fleshy lobes, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, eerie and menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the fungus alone, no bark, no tree, no ground, no background, the whole fungus inside the picture
